question: If an enemy spell chooses my Deflect unit twice, does it have to pay the Deflect cost twice?
change: Up to v1.3 Deflect added its cost once to an enemy spell or ability that chose the unit. v1.4 makes it apply to spells that target the unit, once for each time they choose it. Old answer: once. Current: twice.
